acceptance.assertion: The canonical proposal validator rejects ordinary compound street addresses and representative international street-number forms, including Musterstraße 12 in Berlin and Am Feldweg 7 in Hamburg, without relying on a single standalone street keyword.

The validator rejects latitude/longitude pairs written with decimal points, decimal commas or degrees-minutes-seconds notation, including 52,5200; 13,4050 and 52°31′12″N 13°24′36″E, while avoiding a blanket ban on unrelated numbers.

The same sensitive-location policy is applied to every free-text proposal field copied into the public GitHub issue body, including name, description, region and editorial note, and field-specific validation feedback remains understandable.
Negative tests prove that country names, city names and broad regional descriptions without a street address or coordinate pair remain valid in representative German and English cases.

Browser, schema and offline proposal validators use one canonical sensitive-location contract or prove exact parity through shared fixtures; no validation surface silently accepts content another rejects.
Rejected sensitive content cannot reach buildIssueBody or any public issue-handoff path, and tests prove that no issue body or handoff URL is produced after validation failure.

The exact implementation head passes focused privacy tests, complete repository validation, applicable browser smoke, diff-bound self-review and all required GitHub checks before merge; post-merge Pages and production readback remain exact-SHA bound.

approval.note: The user explicitly authorized publication of this reviewed task and implementation in an isolated Commonworld worktree. Keep the change privacy-focused; do not add external services, costs or collection of submitted text.

goal: Prevent private street addresses and coordinates in every Commonworld proposal field that can reach a public GitHub issue, while preserving legitimate country, city and broad-region descriptions and keeping browser, schema and offline validation behavior consistent.

does_not_establish: that a real private address has already been published
permission to transmit proposal text to an external detection service
permission to block all precise public locations regardless of context
automatic claim, merge, deployment or production-verification authority

operator_intake_publication.fallback_reason: The typed publisher was fail-closed because the deployed Bureau release identity did not match the current canonical registry. This task is therefore registered through an isolated one-file branch and exact-diff review without touching the foreign dirty canonical checkout.

rollback.strategy: Revert the canonical sensitive-location detector, its shared fixtures and handoff gate together; retain the previous validation path only after exact regression tests confirm the public issue handoff no longer depends on partially reverted logic.

title: Harden public proposal privacy validation
